name: 30474 · Vidalia, GA
findings: ZIP 30474 (Vidalia) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30474 (Vidalia) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
45% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30474 (Vidalia) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).
